title: Casting with a Staff
text: A staff reads spells from an equipped crystal grid in a repeating sequence. Each shot spends mana based on its spell crystal's authored cost; installed crystals are not consumed.

Right-click with a staff in either hand to cast; main-hand interactions take priority. Sneak-right-click a main-hand staff to open the grid. An offhand staff casts once per press, before a main-hand weapon begins its held ability. The tip sets shot count, interval and base cooldown. Hold Shift to inspect parts, enhancements and runes.

Multiple shots spend mana individually; insufficient mana, changing staffs or interrupting the cast stops the rest. Total cooldown reduction is capped at 50% and does not shorten the burst interval. Base cooldown is at least one second, or half a second after reduction.

Inside a spell chain, cooldown follows the staff tip. Completing a cycle uses a four-second base cooldown, even with one spell. Two-shot staffs begin cooldown after both shots. Staffs share the grid's casting cooldown; guns and swords cool their own spells per item.
